description:
Mutation capture resolves no issue-linked document closure; document evidence stays with validation.

## Background

Mutation capture resolves the closure of documents an issue links, plus pinned-revision evidence and linked-worktree evidence, so a mutation could certify that the documents it read had not moved. Earlier perf work narrowed mutations to plan documents; the remainder goes now, because the governing decision keeps issue-linked documents with validation.

What survives is the whole-repository validation closure, a different construct with a similar name, and the plan documents a transition rule reads.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No mutation document-closure function, closure type alias, or document-capture selector survives in the mutation path.
- [hard] REQ-02: A mutation captures the plan documents a transition rule consults, and captures no other document.
- [hard] REQ-03: Validation resolves pinned-revision evidence and linked-worktree evidence, with the mutation path free of both.
- [hard] REQ-04: The whole-repository validation closure is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-05: Document-link checking keeps reporting the dangling links it reports today.
- [hard] REQ-06: The change removes more lines than it adds.
title: Mutation document closure retirement
